defects.detail: the two commentary (ṭīkā) blocks, about half the page ('उन्निद्रविकसितपङ्कजस्य कर्णिकावालयस्थानं ... तदपोह्य त्यक्त्वा' and 'परंपरं जंघाजान्वादि धारयेत् ... प्राणान् नियच्छेत् इत्यर्थः'), are not translated at all; only the verses 10–15 are rendered
v.15 'जितासुः' (having conquered the breath) rendered 'having conquered his senses'
v.14 'परावरे' (the higher-and-lower, i.e. Lord of all) rendered 'the Supreme Soul'

reason: verses 10–15 rendered faithfully apart from 'jitāsuḥ' as 'conquered his senses'; the commentary above and below the verses, roughly half the page, is dropped entirely; Sanskrit read moderately
image_note: minor, unsure at this resolution: lower commentary image 'ध्यायेत् शुद्ध्यति तस्मिन्निश्चला' vs transcription 'ध्यायेत् युक्त्या ततस्मान् निश्चला'; v.10 image 'योगेश्वरास्थापित' vs 'योगेश्वरस्थापित'
